description: This file contains a set of assertion functions used in unit testing, such as assertEqualsM, assertEqualsM5, and related methods, primarily for floating-point comparisons and simple validation in testing frameworks.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM5(const char * prefix,const char * message,float expected,float actual,float EPS)
methods.description: Compares two floating-point values with a specified epsilon, with a message prefix, and reports failure and exits if they differ.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM2(const char * msg,float expected,float actual,float eps)
methods.description: Wrapper around assertEqualsM5 with default epsilon, for simple message-based float comparison.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM4(const char * prefix,const char * msg,float expected,float actual)
methods.description: Wrapper around assertEqualsM5 with a fixed epsilon, used for approximate float equality.

methods.name: void assertEqualsLM(const char * msg,long expected,long actual)
methods.description: Checks equality of two long integers, reports and exits if unequal.

methods.name: void assertEqualsM(const char * msg,float expected,float actual)
methods.description: Wrapper around assertEqualsM2, for float comparison with default epsilon.

methods.name: void chDbgAssert(int c,char * msg,void * arg)
methods.description: Engineered assertion that reports failure and exits if condition c is false.
